description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry' responsible for managing a registry of JSON parsable classes based on annotations. It includes methods for initializing and merging parsing strategies, utilizing reflection to discover annotated classes. The class extends a base registry and employs factory patterns for creating parsable strategies.

classes.name: AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract registry managing JSON parsable classes discovered via annotations, parameterized by superclass T and annotation type A.

methods.name: AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the registry with the superclass, annotation class, and factory; sets up parse strategies.

methods.name: AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry
methods.description: Overloaded constructor allowing additional parse strategies to merge.

methods.name: mergeParsingStrategies
methods.description: Merges two maps of parsing strategies, with the second overriding the first where keys overlap.

methods.name: initAnnotationBasedParseStrategies
methods.description: Discovers annotated classes using ClassIndex, filters by assignability, retrieves annotations, and creates strategies via a factory.
